---
name: Recipe for another tool
about: Propose or request a source or fault recipe for a gateway, model server, tracing tool, log platform, vector store or egress source

---

**Tool and version**

**Layer** (data, processing, model state, logs) **and what it stores**

**How to read it** (command or API, and the read-only permission it needs)

**Anything easy to get wrong** (default limits, pagination, time windows, encodings)

**Tested against a real instance?** yes / no
